text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — elevated 502/504s observed for /v1/generate/stream in eu-west-1 (rule: api.gateway.5xx_rate > 10%). Current 2m window: 26% 5xx, spike started ~02:10 UTC. Top upstream errors: k-embedder (connection reset).

alice: I'm on it. paging @jordan @mike @netops

jordan: I see the Grafana dash — request volume up ~30% from batch replay traffic to streaming path. 502s correlate with higher concurrent gRPC streams. timeline: started ~02:10, sharp until mitigation.

mike: Envoy logs show repeated `upstream connection termination` and `RST_STREAM`. Looks like downstream embedder is resetting long-lived stream connections. Canary deploy of embedder v2.3.1 yesterday — suspicious.

alice: Can we just route streaming traffic out of eu-west-1 to eu-central-1 temporarily? Any sticky session concerns?

netops: We can patch LB rules for route /v1/generate/stream -> eu-central-1. Doing a staged change now, will preserve cookie path. Pushing change in 30s.

sre-lead: Fast mitigations (pick two): (1) enable circuit-breaker on embedder cluster (limit concurrent streams/pending) (2) route streaming to fallback non-streaming endpoint (degrades UX but prevents errors) (3) rollback embedder canary if correlation holds. Apply 1 + 2 now.

jordan: Applying envoy circuit-breaker patch to embedder cluster:
```
# patch envoy cluster limits
kubectl apply -f k8s/envoy/embedder-circuit-breaker.yaml --context=cluster-eu-west-1
```

mike: Toggled emergency feature flag `streaming_fallback=true` (LaunchDarkly). This forces most streaming calls to fall back to chunked non-stream generation. Triggered at 02:18 UTC.

incident-bot: feature-flag streaming_fallback set to true by mike at 02:18 UTC

alice: Rolling back embedder canary -> set image to v2.3.0 in prod canary:
```
kubectl set image deploy/k-embedder k-embedder=redwood/k-embedder:v2.3.0 -n prod
```

netops: LB route change applied: /v1/generate/stream now routes to eu-central-1 pool for edge requests from EU region. Cookie TTL preserved. Confirming propagation across POPs.

jordan: After circuit-breaker + fallback + LB route, 5xx dropped from 26% -> 6% in ~4m. Streaming-specific 5xx: 27% -> 4.8%. Good signal.

mike: Customer impact summary: ~12 customers affected (mostly PLG heavy streamers). They saw degraded streaming (fell back to non-interactive chunked responses). Support notified with templated message.

alice: Filing incident ticket INC-2026-4132 (Sev2). Owners: eng-runtime, netops. Creating postmortem skeleton and action items.

sre-lead: Current state: mitigations applied (circuit-breaker, streaming fallback, embedder rollback, LB routing). Error rate stabilized ~3.1% across gateway. Keep monitoring for 30m before declaring triage closed.

netops: Monitoring LB metrics for retransmits and session mismatches; checking whether CDN cache invalidation or prefix caching caused bursts.

alice: Next steps: postmortem with root cause (investigate embedder v2.3.1 and streaming regression), add synthetic checks for streaming endpoints, enforce canary gating for long-lived stream behavior, add automation to fallback on embedder reset signature. Owner: jordan. ETA: EOD.

sre-lead: Handoff -> next on-call is @mike in 10m. Please watch for any reversion above 8% 5xx. Postmortem link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-4132

mike: Acknowledged. Monitoring and will escalate if we see >8% again. Thanks all :thumbsup:
